desc: Ideation complete: chose reverse iteration + Fenwick tree for O(N log N).
Parse N and the array P of length N.
Initialize a Fenwick tree (Binary Indexed Tree) of size N with all 1s and prepare an answer list of size N (0-indexed).
Implement BIT methods: add(idx, delta), sum(idx) prefix query, and find_kth(k) using binary lifting (largest power of two >= N).
Iterate i from N down to 1: k = P[i-1] (since P is 0-indexed in Python), pos = find_kth(k), set ans[pos-1] = i, update BIT at pos with -1.
